title: nan
authors: Luo X.; Du X.; Yue S.; Lv Y.; Zhang L.; He X.; Wu W.; Mao J.
key_contribution: Presents DTVIRM-Swarm, a distributed anchor-free tightly integrated visual-inertial-UWB-magnetic system for UAV swarm cooperative localization in GNSS-denied environments, with real-world validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
